answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The gale holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
